steps.content: When Coquelic regains consciousness, she finds herself in a bizarre space.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Where is this place?

This is an incredibly grand triangular hall, nearly a hundred meters tall. She tries to discern the details, but the more she looks, the higher and farther away the top seems. She gives up. Surprisingly calm, she clearly knows this is not something she can measure.
Behind her is a hazy view, and in front of her is a ray of light that seems to touch the depths of her soul. Something is waiting for her. Coquelic steps forward.

Slowly, the corridor narrows while the dome gets higher. The initially slanted walls on either side gradually open upwards, eventually forming tall vertical barriers, as if constantly urging her to turn back.
Coquelic continues to move forward. Eventually, she exits the narrow passage, arriving in an open, boundless, deathly silent space.
Shalom stands in the center. Behind her, a vertical rift stands quietly, leading to an unseen top, the only light in this darkness.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Welcome, Mentor. You've successfully infiltrated.
Coquelic raises her hand to draw her sword, but a blue light pierces through her arm before she can muster her strength, dissolving it instantly.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Would you kindly refrain from using your power? You can tell me if you've any funny ideas, but refrain from doing anything. In this space, both Mania and rebellion are absolutely "prohibited."

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Really?
As she says this, she forcefully plunges her bare hand into Shalom's chest. Blood seeps out, but Shalom shows no signs of pain. Instead, a sharp blue light pierces Coquelic's hand from thin air.
This isn't Shalom's power, but something from a higher rule, higher than everything here and now. But Coquelic remains unfazed.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: If this is my "punishment," then it's no big deal.
Having said that, she pulls out her hand, grabs Shalom's neck, and throws her forcefully onto the ground. Several light spikes pierce her back once more.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Quite the Paradeisos tech, I can't kill you here, can I? Whose consciousness space is this?
Shalom smiles but doesn't say a word. Instead, her laughter echoes directly in Coquelic's mind, causing her to pull back her hand abruptly, her skin prickling.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Did I scare you? I couldn't speak because my throat was being crushed, so I had to communicate directly with your consciousness. Unsettling, isn't it?
As she says this, she stands up, dusts off her skirt, and faces Coquelic.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: This consciousness space is the rational boundary constructed by Paradeisos. It's under heavy protection, the front line for observing Mania.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Oh... So, does that mean the center of DisSea is behind that rift?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Not that deep, but indeed closer to the source than the usual Black Ring. That's why there are stricter defense rules here, including controlling our impulsive behaviors. All to prevent Mania from the other side from seeping in.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're a Sinner, and an unexpected visitor at that. You must be uncomfortable here.

She's right. Coquelic looks at her hands. Even without doing anything, a layer of fine blue light appears, prickling her with a numbing pain. It's like the Blue Rain is suppressing her power, warning her of something.
Coquelic looks at Shalom again. The Hush has no marks on her, and she looks calm.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You're also a Sinner. Why are you unaffected?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Because I've always been here. I'm familiar with all the rules and have mastered them. Therefore, no matter how complex the rules are, they can't restrict my freedom.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I'm a Sinner, the <color=#fb9259>7th generation Hush</color>. Paradeisos separated my emotions and sent them to the other side of the rift. This way, the purely rational me can stay on the front line, while the emotional side dives into Mania, observing the changes in the world and human hearts for them.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...So this is the "technology" that shocked the Underground. Disgusting. No wonder you look like a heartless puppet.
Shalom reveals a puppet-like smile.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: This is a cruel era. People always face complex and unsolvable dilemmas. They need someone to observe the situation, analyze changes, provide solutions, and execute them. I'm good at these, my job is to accept requests and find the right answers in deadlocks.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: So now, I can help you too.
Coquelic bursts into laughter.

steps.speaker: Special times call for special measures! Aim for the gates and fire!
steps.content: Hahahah! Help me? After what you've done, you want to patch up the torn mask and let me listen to your nonsense? Do you think I'm a fool?!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Of course, you're not a fool, so hear me out. You know very well, even without me, hundreds of others would come after you. And I'm the only one who is still willing to talk to you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The fate of the Garden was sealed long ago. Having been captured by the Underground when you had nowhere to go, you were destined to be torn apart in the crossfire. This is the fate of those caught in the conflict's ruthless grip.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: A new round of war is about to begin. With or without me, escape seems destined to elude you. That's why you're struggling so hard.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: But the sanctuary you built with your life is destined to crumble with your life's end. This time, even vengeance can't save you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: There's no time left. Even if you kill me, slaughter everyone in the Underground or Paradeisos, and overthrow the whole world... you won't have time to find new flowers. Your ruins can't be reborn. You know this better than I do.
Coquelic glares at Shalom. After a while, her eyes become tired.
Perhaps she's exhausted. The battle just now was so exhilarating. She has squandered too much of her vitality in a reckless manner. The Mentor wants to rest. Weakly, she averts her gaze and asks.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: So? What's your point?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I can give you life, give you time to find a new Garden, and keep you far away from all the troubles.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You make it sound like you can calculate everything.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I've already calculated your arrival here, so naturally, I can calculate your salvation.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Before that, am I to serve Paradeisos?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: No, you only need to listen to me, just this once.
The Hush approaches Coquelic, the expression on her face becoming more ambiguous and unfathomable.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: This is the only place they can't touch, so they make so many rules to control the risks. Only I have been approved, granted permission to enter here, and you forced your way in by defeating me.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I am glad. What I am about to say next, it is only between us.
She stops half a step in front of the Mentor. Before being disgustingly pierced by Coquelic, Shalom lifts both hands to hold the Mentor's cheeks, forcing her to look directly into her eyes.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I have the ability to keep you alive, to protect your Garden. All you have to do is help me do one thing, to find <color=#fb9259>someone</color>.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The Chief of Minos, the holder of the shackles, ${PlayerName}. He disappeared in the Rustfire uprising in the West District, the shackles were contaminated and spread by the Corpseborne. Under the intervention of the Black Ring, neither MBCC nor Paradeisos could find him through sensing.
steps.female_content: The Chief of Minos, the holder of the shackles, ${PlayerName}. She disappeared in the Rustfire uprising in the West District, the shackles were contaminated and spread by the Corpseborne. Under the intervention of the Black Ring, neither MBCC nor Paradeisos could find her through sensing.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Those hiding him are very capable, but soon more people will come looking, and no one will be able to hide him any longer.
steps.female_content: Those hiding her are very capable, but soon more people will come looking, and no one will be able to hide her any longer.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I want you to use your ability as the Master of the Garden, the ability to slip through the cracks, and find him before anyone else.
steps.female_content: I want you to use your ability as the Master of the Garden, the ability to slip through the cracks, and find her before anyone else.

steps.content: Shalom's face still remains as impassive as a wax figure, but the force in her hands gradually increases, carrying an undeniable will.
...This woman is serious. Realizing this, Coquelic bursts into dumbfounded laughter.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I see, it's that person who Sumire misses... But didn't you kill him? Isn't he also a casualty of your fight with the Underground?
steps.female_content: I see, it's that person who Sumire misses... But didn't you kill her? Isn't she also a casualty of your fight with the Underground?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Yes, it was carefully planned by me. I received the mission, pondered carefully, and cautiously led him to a dead end in the turbulent situation.
steps.female_content: Yes, it was carefully planned by me. I received the mission, pondered carefully, and cautiously led her to a dead end in the turbulent situation.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Then why are you looking for him? To exterminate him, to make up for the failure at that time? Or now that the situation is out of control, you want to catch him back as a dog?
steps.female_content: Then why are you looking for her? To exterminate her, to make up for the failure at that time? Or now that the situation is out of control, you want to catch her back as a dog?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: No, I want you to find him, and then, <color=#fb9259>kill anyone who comes looking for him</color>, stay in the dark until he wakes up. Apart from this, you don't have to do anything else.
steps.female_content: No, I want you to find her, and then, <color=#fb9259>kill anyone who comes looking for her</color>, stay in the dark until she wakes up. Apart from this, you don't have to do anything else.

steps.content: Coquelic is stunned.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Are you out of your mind?
Shalom tilts her head and actually starts laughing.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: No? I painstakingly made my way here, step by step, finally found a solution, I even wanted to be proud of it.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Even if he lost his memory, he's a rare troublemaker who can really hurt both sides.
steps.female_content: Even if she lost her memory, she's a rare troublemaker who can really hurt both sides.

steps.content: Shalom's smile deepens, which somehow gives Coquelic the creeps.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>shackles</color> are carefully studied and used by Paradeisos. First, they suppressed the Sinner, then dealt with Mania, and then tried to suppress the Black Ring...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: For ten years, Paradeisos needed this power and strived to chase the truth behind it, but could never fully understand it, nor dare to let its guard down.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...Because those were the craziest creations of <color=#fb9259>the Underground</color>. Born from the Lone Island in DisSea, fed by the Black Ring, and ultimately leading to the source. It's the <color=#fb9259>ultimate container</color> created by those madmen who wanted to steal Mania, and the revival of Mania is Paradeisos's greatest fear.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: After receiving this news, Paradeisos took action at all costs, broke into DisSea, made huge sacrifices to destroy the Lone Island, and severely damaged the Underground. It was a great victory that must be silenced, and what they brought back was such a fearful existence.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You were in the Garden at that time, you should remember.
She remembers.

Ten years ago, the <color=#fb9259>defeat</color> that shook the whole city-state, the <color=#fb9259>meaningless</color> sacrifice. Coquelic recalls the things she had thrown behind her mind out of disgust back then.

N.F. 103,
Courtyard of the Garden

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...It's you, coming so suddenly, how annoying.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The Mentor isn't here, you can look for her tomorrow.

steps.speaker: Segal
steps.content: ...Urgent mission... Garden, eliminate our enemies...

steps.speaker: Segal
steps.content: Anyone will do, just send everyone. Those people on the list, find them and kill them all.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Tch, that woman is at your beck and call, but I'm not—

steps.speaker: Segal
steps.content: Kill them! Reckless fools! Dare to touch that place! Who do they think they are!

steps.speaker: Segal
steps.content: *** was destroyed, *** was taken away, and they even dared to hurt ***!! Kill them, kill them all!!

That was the only time she saw the pretentious woman from the Underground so angry and desperate. During those two years, the Underground's mad assassination commissions kept pressing on the Garden's doorstep. Her Mentor at that time kept asking her to do boring and despicable "work."

...So many innocent people have cried their eyes dry and are scarred all over, left with nowhere to go but to knock on the gates of the Garden. This is a covert and vicious war, with both sides intent on annihilating the enemy, and the brutal consequences are borne by those outside the war.
How ridiculous, how absurd, how shameless. Those memories she once sneered at and dismissed from her mind, she now recalls them all, understands them all.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Ha, haha... I see... So that's how it is...
She brushes off the hand of the Paradeisos Hush.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You've stolen the enemy's knife, find it awkward to use, yet are reluctant to toss it away. When the real battle comes, you start fearing that the enemy's mysterious trick might backfire on you. So in the end, you break it, melt it, and use it as a mere prop, right?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Yes. He gained too much power, gradually approaching his origin. Paradeisos got scared and enacted the strictest rules to prevent him from swallowing the Black Rings any further. Once, twice... by the third time, he was undoubtedly doomed.
steps.female_content: Yes. She gained too much power, gradually approaching her origin. Paradeisos got scared and enacted the strictest rules to prevent her from swallowing the Black Rings any further. Once, twice... by the third time, she was undoubtedly doomed.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Talking big, but in the end, aren't you just a coward? Not just a coward, but also hypocritical, arrogant, delusional, and cruel. Who do you think you are?!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Yes, this is <color=#fb9259>Paradeisos</color>... desperately seeking the truth, the correct answer, yet also fearing risks and the unknown, terrified of disaster striking again. They established so many rules and safeguards, protecting against everything but also driving themselves and everyone else to a dead end.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: As for what the <color=#fb9259>Underground</color> is like, you know better than I do, don't you?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I'm not like them, but I know that you two are just dogs fighting each other! Don't act like you're the hero just because you fought the bad guys!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Exactly, one side can sacrifice everything to resist Mania, while the other side can sacrifice everything to obtain Mania. The disaster hasn't even awakened yet, and humans have already fallen into madness, fighting each other and burning everything to the ground.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You should all go to hell together, how dare you drag the others into this!!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Yes, it will happen, but before that...
Shalom grabs Coquelic's wrist again. This time, the Mentor can't break free. Upon looking up, the woman's face is already close.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Don't you want to see other possibilities? Don't you want to reject this foolish path? Just do as I say, go find him.
steps.female_content: Don't you want to see other possibilities? Don't you want to reject this foolish path? Just do as I say, go find her.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I've already destroyed the <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> that bind him, sent him away from all surveillance, to a place even I can't reach. But this isn't enough.
steps.female_content: I've already destroyed the <color=#fb9259>Rules</color> that bind her, sent her away from all surveillance, to a place even I can't reach. But this isn't enough.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The Second Black Ring</color> carries everything of the West District, it is destined to revive and turn into a storm again. As the <color=#fb9259>Shepherd</color> connected to it, he will inevitably be fought over again. It's time to move to the next stage. Please, go to the place that I can't.
steps.female_content: <color=#fb9259>The Second Black Ring</color> carries everything of the West District, it is destined to revive and turn into a storm again. As the <color=#fb9259>Shepherd</color> connected to it, she will inevitably be fought over again. It's time to move to the next stage. Please, go to the place that I can't.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You are the strongest among the crossfire, only you have been able to navigate both sides over the years, capable of keeping him from falling into either side's hands. This time, you just need to protect one person, you can do it.
steps.female_content: You are the strongest among the crossfire, only you have been able to navigate both sides over the years, capable of keeping her from falling into either side's hands. This time, you just need to protect one person, you can do it.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...Ha, what, are you only talking about betraying Paradeisos now?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: What are you talking about? During my term, I was always the most efficient Hush, I fulfilled every demand, no one could accuse me of betrayal.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It's just that in this increasingly stagnant stalemate, I casually loosen the binds on a little monster.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Another tool of yours, huh? What are you planning for him this time?
steps.female_content: Another tool of yours, huh? What are you planning for her this time?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Why should I plan anything for him? That's the most troublesome, hardest to use, and most uncontrollable tool. For a guy like him, you should set him free and let him cause chaos.
steps.female_content: Why should I plan anything for her? That's the most troublesome, hardest to use, and most uncontrollable tool. For a girl like her, you should set her free and let her cause chaos.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Go set him free, Coquelic. Like you, he's also destined to belong to no one. Whether you want to take revenge on Paradeisos, the Underground, or fate, this is an opportunity. Let him cause a huge commotion, you'll enjoy it.
steps.female_content: Go set her free, Coquelic. Like you, she's also destined to belong to no one. Whether you want to take revenge on Paradeisos, the Underground, or fate, this is an opportunity. Let her cause a huge commotion, you'll enjoy it.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: As payment for the commission, whether you want to use my power to survive and seek rebirth, or to destroy me and swing your sword towards greater heights, you can try both.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: No one else will give you a chance besides me.
She finishes speaking and waits for Coquelic's reply. The Mentor looks into Shalom's eyes, those hollow eyes now seem sincere because of their emptiness.
No lies, no disguises, no impurities. After all the meticulous planning, it's such a covert <color=#fb9259>commission</color> that takes so much effort to deliver into my hands... How stupid.
If she had come to me for help earlier, maybe I would have considered it. If she hadn't done those unnecessary things, maybe the Garden could have used this woman for something.
If only I had known there were other choices earlier...
Too bad. There won't be. She has long stopped thinking about "what ifs."

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Heh... once I've rested, I might consider going. But I don't need to borrow his power to take revenge. When I do things, I don't need to rely on others.
steps.female_content: Heh... once I've rested, I might consider going. But I don't need to borrow her power to take revenge. When I do things, I don't need to rely on others.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: It's just to see what that heart-stealing thief is capable of, to make my little Garden fool cry so pitifully.
Coquelic breaks free from the Hush's hand once again, takes two steps back, and completely distances herself from Shalom.
She looks at Shalom and thinks of something funny.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Haha... I now know how that little blonde felt when she was scolding me...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Evil is evil. It doesn't matter what your stance or reasons are. Casually brushing over the debts we owe in the course of your self-serving talk. In this respect, we are both filled with evil.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're right. Cutting costs is just my personal interest, fulfilling demands is the absolute goal, and "necessary sacrifices" are a common means. This is their will. Witness how it's carried out through <color=#fb9259>me</color>, and you will have no room for wishful thinking.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Sacrifice this today, sacrifice that tomorrow, how much to sacrifice is all up to you. Haha... who do you think you are?!
Shalom quietly looks at her, after a long while, she responds with a smile.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...Just a tool that broke secretly during its use period.

Coquelic bursts into laughter. Behind her, the pale blue rift suddenly expands, emitting an eerie light that keeps inching closer. It seems to be attracted to Coquelic, its dazzling glow nearly swallowing her whole.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...I won't live long enough to see that day. I don't want the life you're offering, nor do I want to wait that long to take revenge. No matter whose orders you're following, or how many people are involved... you're the one who disturbed my Garden. So that's that, life is short.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: If compared to the <color=#fb9259>righteousness</color> of Paradeisos and the <color=#fb9259>long-standing wishes</color> of the Underground, we're insignificant... If we can be sacrificed at any time, then it doesn't matter if I'm a bit stubborn, a bit rebellious, right?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Now that I'm as light as a feather, it wouldn't matter if I act recklessly, right?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You and this place are both important to Paradeisos?
She slowly approaches the rift. She can hear the strange noises coming from behind it.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Since this rift is something you can't touch...
Coquelic thrusts her hand into the rift. The blue light surges into her body, but she pays no mind, only pushing deeper into it.

The space suddenly shakes violently, a blinding white light tearing through the calm like a sword. From the bottom of the rift, ice-blue crystallized flowers spread, bringing with them the stirring aura of Mania.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You've always pretended to understand me. Then you should know, I wouldn't possibly listen to you.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I can't stand your so-called "righteousness." I'm nothing but a tiny assassin caught in the crossfire. My prey, those who hunt me, those who seek my help, none of them are good people. I've strayed from the path, and I will not accept your "righteousness."

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The hell with your "right answer"... Letting me in was your mistake, destroying my Garden was your mistake! Whatever I do from now on has nothing to do with you. Now, pay with your life!

An insane power poured in, Coquelic hadn't felt so full of life in a long time. From the rift, she pulls out a strange long sword, emitting a deafening roar. Following this, Mania gushes out from the other side.

The Hush didn't stop it. From the collapsed rift, glowing tendrils writhed out, casting wild light that hit Shalom's face, reflecting a frozen smile with a hint of eerie cracks, as if her long-standing wish had been fulfilled.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: This is fine... This time, I'm not holding back either.
